policy: Every authored visualState must appear here with a disposition. An explicit authored state is authoritative: src/equipment/liquidRendering/styles.ts and src/equipment/solidRendering.ts resolve it from this file first and consult the fallbacks below only when an instance authors no state at all, or authors one whose disposition is nonvisual. quantitativeClaim may be "none" or "ordinal" and never "absolute": appearance alone must not imply a measured value. A `runtime-assigned` state must also declare `runtimeAssignment`: `default` when an authored value wins and the literal is only the fallback, `unconditional` when the reducer decides and no authored value reaches that site. The content checker re-reads the reducer and fails when the two disagree.

dispositions.liquid-style: Rendered as a liquid body from this entry's renderStyle. src/equipment/liquidRendering/styles.ts builds LIQUID_STYLES from these entries; it holds no palette of its own.
dispositions.solid-style: Rendered as a solid or precipitate region from this entry's solidStyle, through src/equipment/solidRendering.ts.
dispositions.state-asset: Rendered as a whole-apparatus asset through stateAssets in src/equipment/visualCatalog.ts.
dispositions.nonvisual: Intentionally has no distinct appearance. Not debt. The container fallbacks may apply.
dispositions.unresolved: Authored but resolves to neither a style nor a state asset today. Carried as debt with an owning cycle; it renders the default appearance and is never silently replaced by a label heuristic.

evidenceKinds.source-observed: A dated source plan states this appearance, or names it as a required observation.
evidenceKinds.measurement-derived: The appearance participates in a measurement method, so it may not be chosen for presentation reasons. Only the cycle that owns the procedure may set it.
evidenceKinds.simulator-configured: Assigned by the runtime during play rather than authored in content.
evidenceKinds.qualitative: A named appearance that conveys kind or stage only. No source plan states a colour for it.
evidenceKinds.presentation-only: Exists for presentation. Makes no claim about the substance at all.

selectors.authored: Reachable because content authors this exact visualState today.
selectors.definition-id: Reachable through the fallbacks.definitionIdStates table when an instance authors no state.
selectors.reagent-heuristic: Reachable through the fallbacks.reagentKeywordStates table when an instance authors no state.
selectors.runtime-assigned: Reachable because the runtime sets it during play.

fallbacks.policy: Consulted only when an instance has no visualState, or when its visualState is registered nonvisual. An authored state that resolves wins outright; an authored state that does not resolve falls through to defaultLiquidState or defaultSolidState and is reported by visual-state/unresolved or visual-state/unregistered, never quietly replaced by a heuristic.
fallbacks.reagentKeywordSource: Normalized `${equipmentDefinition.label} ${contents.label}`, tested in the order listed.

states.provenance: Reachable only through the definition-id override or reagent-name heuristic in resolveLiquidStyle, not through an authored visualState.
